summary.text: Heather Baldwin is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 4 who has held the seat since December 7, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired educator, she succeeded Roderick Ladd (R) in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Heather Baldwin lives in Thornton, New Hampshire, and earned an undergraduate degree in biology and a master's degree in education from Plymouth State University.
Her career experience includes working as a biology teacher at Plymouth State University, and she has served on the Thornton School Board.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Baldwin said she and her husband have raised eight children in Thornton Gore and that she taught biology at Plymouth State for many years.
She listed her campaign priorities as keeping New Hampshire's public school system strong, preserving natural resources, and promoting respectful political discourse and bipartisan solutions.
Baldwin took office on December 7, 2022, succeeding Roderick Ladd (R), and in the 2023-2024 session was assigned to the Resources, Recreation and Development Committee.
